data.one_liner: Generates MobX store boilerplate from @observable, @computed and @action annotations.
data.what_it_does: Runs build_runner to create *.g.dart files that implement MobX reactivity for annotated store classes. Lets you write clean abstract stores and get generated mixins automatically.
use_when: You want MobX state management with compile‑time generated code
You prefer annotations over manual boilerplate
You already use build_runner in your project
avoid_when: You need a pure Dart/Flutter solution without code generation
You prefer other state‑management patterns like Provider or Riverpod
strengths: Keeps store definitions concise and type‑safe
weaknesses: Requires build_runner step and generated files
Only works with MobX, not other state‑management libs
data.setup_notes: Add mobx_codegen to dev_dependencies, run `flutter pub run build_runner build` after defining abstract Store classes
